name: 雷吉内德
title: 帝国机兵
text:
贝利亚军利用从艾斯美拉鲁达行星掠夺的资源和技术制造的量产侵略先遣机械兵，能从眼部发射光束。更换手臂和腿部组件可承担不同任务；陆战型α配钻头及自行滚轮，宇宙战型β配炮筒及推进喷嘴，两类分别量产部署。

身高：53米。体重：35,000吨。
version_scope: 本图只对应万代78明确标注的陆战型α（双钻头）；宇宙战型β、后作定制机不共用本图。
unit_note: 按原字段明确米/吨；不把商品厘米当角色骨长或物理身高。
source_label: 圆谷官方本人图鉴（简体中文整理）

fact_sources.original_description: The Empire Machine Soldiers which were manufactured using resources and technology seized from Planet Esmeralda by Kaiser Belial's army, and are deployed as vanguards of invasion. Their weapon is a beam fired from their eyes. They can be used for multiple purposes by exchanging their arm and leg units. Both ground combat type (α) equipped with drill attachments and self-propelled rollers, and space combat type (β) equipped with cannon attachments and booster nozzles are mass-produced and deployed respectively.
